sources.description: Written by python-lz4 1.9.4 (liblz4 1.9.4), python-zstandard 0.25 (zstd 1.5) and CPython's lzma module (liblzma 5) through hexplain-tools codecs/lz/src/test/resources/codec/generate_vectors.py and codecs/xz/src/test/resources/codec/generate_xz_vectors.py; single-byte corruptions, truncations and concatenations made here.
Chunks written by numcodecs 0.16.5 (numpy 2.3.2, Python 3.11.4) through hexplain-tools tests/gdal/zarr_codec_vectors.py (core/src/test/resources/zarr/numcodecs-vectors.json).

Round trips worked by hand from the codec's definition (a transform) or fed through the previous step's output (a compressor, whose encoded bytes are the implementation's own: the encode step expects success only, and the decode step reads its output back to the input).
